chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
There is no problem with the exclusive Umrah during the months of Hajj. Then he can return to his family.

key_terms.أَشْهُرِ الْحَجِّ: Months of Hajj (Dhu al-Qi'dah, Dhu al-Hijjah, and the first ten days of Muharram)
key_terms.الْعُمْرَةِ الْمُفْرَدَةِ: Exclusive Umrah (Umrah performed independently, not combined with Hajj)
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: There is no problem / It is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform Umrah separately during the months of Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the permissibility of performing Umrah al-Mufrada (independent Umrah) during the Hajj months, distinguishing it from the combined Hajj and Umrah (Qiran or Tamattu'). It reflects the Shia juristic view that the pilgrim is not obligated to remain in the state of Ihram for Hajj immediately after Umrah, allowing for flexibility in ritual practice and the option to return home before the Hajj season concludes.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is no problem with the exclusive Umra during the months of Hajj. Then he can return to his family’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
there is no offense in performing al-‘Umrah al- Mufradah (without al-Hajj) during the months of al-Hajj and returning home.”
